## File: facebookresearch_mvfst-rl/third-party/torchbeast/third_party/grpc/third_party/benchmark/tools/compare.py

Prompts

```
['run compare.py benchmarks to compare two benchmark JSON output files or executables side by side', 'run compare.py filters to compare two different filters from the same benchmark file', 'run compare.py benchmarksfiltered to compare a filter from one benchmark against a filter from another', 'run compare.py with --alpha flag to set significance level for Mann-Whitney U statistical test', 'run compare.py with -a flag to display only aggregate results when benchmarks have many repetitions', 'run strip_asm.py with an input assembly file path and output file path to generate a stripped assembly file', 'process an assembly string to strip unwanted directives, comments, and global declarations using process_asm', 'transform assembly labels by normalizing them and removing unused local label declarations using transform_labels', 'process identifiers in an assembly line to normalize Mach-O underscore prefixes for cross-platform consistency', 'find all used local labels referenced by jump instructions in assembly code using find_used_labels']
```

Usage

```
{'run_benchmark_comparison': 'run compare.py benchmarks to compare two benchmark JSON output files or executables side by side', 'run_filtered_comparison': 'run compare.py filters to compare two different filters from the same benchmark file', 'run_cross_benchmark_filtered_comparison': 'run compare.py benchmarksfiltered to compare a filter from one benchmark against a filter from another', 'run_comparison_with_utest': 'run compare.py with --alpha flag to set significance level for Mann-Whitney U statistical test', 'run_comparison_aggregates_only': 'run compare.py with -a flag to display only aggregate results when benchmarks have many repetitions'}
```
